production.behavior: VAD -> ASR -> confidence guard -> de-loop -> heuristics

non_speech.dataset: ESC-50 filtered plus deterministic synthetic noise/babble
non_speech.license: ESC-50 CC BY-NC; synthetic samples project-generated

run.paired_method: Run production RobustASR once, then apply experimental BoH to the identical saved outputs.

decision.reason: The model-specific phrase list changed no output and improved no measured quality or robustness metric. Remaining speech-like leaks must be addressed in calibrated VAD/ASR logic, not by a hidden phrase-deletion fallback.
decision.rollback: No automatic rollback. Reintroducing BoH would require a new explicit production decision and release evidence.

limitations: This 80-item Phase 0 freeze is a paired characterization run, not a population-level ASR quality claim.
The non-speech sample contains only five speech-like rows; the 100% subtype leak rate has a wide confidence interval.

AEC is a separate duplex/barge-in signal-boundary component and is not exercised by clean FLEURS/ESC-50 ASR files. Existing real AEC-Challenge replay remains supporting evidence, not part of this paired BoH result.
Local manifests and every selected audio file are SHA-256 recorded in the full artifact, but the original download revision was not stored when the local dataset was first provisioned.
rerun_command: uv run python -m local.eval_table7 --model phowhisper_small --n-speech 30 --n-noise 50 --configs production_no_boh,production_with_boh --output <report.json>
